meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

operator-help.review_note: Cross-checked the existing Commerce Dashboard section and reports guide. The storefront counters keep their 30-day window, valid zero and unavailable states.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed the Dashboard route association against the public MCP and A2UI source boundaries. This owner analytics read uses only the authenticated database transport.

remote-commerce.review_note: Compared the storefront telemetry read with the cart and checkout contracts. The existing cart and checkout writes continue through the documented paths.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed SettingsService module resolution and Merchant feed guidance. Dropping a retired header slot leaves the saved catalog eligibility inputs intact.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed CI and the generated call graph against the workflow guide. The isolated MySQL and MariaDB jobs exercise the exact PHP timestamp cutoff with direct and bridge reads.
